_comment: Test programs. Each run is executed in a fresh scratch directory. {BIN} = programs/bin, {WORKLOADS} = programs/workloads. 'setup' commands run with bash before the traced/jailed command and are NOT traced. 'check' runs afterwards to confirm the program really did its job. The poisoned run = the training run with LD_PRELOAD={BIN}/poison.so (see programs/src/poison.c).

gzip.description: GNU gzip: compresses and decompresses files.

heldout.check: test -f input.txt.gz && test ! -f input.txt && gzip -t input.txt.gz

sqlite3.description: SQLite command-line shell: runs SQL against a database file.

cp.description: GNU cp: copies files and directories.

tar.description: GNU tar: creates and extracts archive files.

mini_httpd.description: Tiny single-request HTTP server written for this project: serves files with sendfile() or lists a directory.

worker.description: Multithreaded worker written for this project: N POSIX threads sum an array under a mutex (N=0 means no threads).

probe.description: Harmless escape probe: tries dangerous syscalls with invalid arguments. Used for the containment check and the visualizer's jailbreak scene.
